supported_claims: PC documentation states sufficiency, acyclicity and faithfulness, with an external independence test and CPDAG output.
FCI search uses circle endpoints and PAG-oriented processing; its class-level CPDAG description should not define interchange semantics.
IDA constructor expects a legal PDAG and continuous dataset; it computes covariance-based regression effect candidates.
getTotalEffects catches candidate-level exceptions and logs them without returning a typed missing-candidate record.
distance uses the interval from minimum to maximum rather than distance to the discrete candidate multiset; an empty candidate list returns trueEffect.
Root POM compiler release 21 and README Java JDK 25+ bridge requirements are distinct source observations requiring an actual environment check.
